name: droverstatus
description: Local web dashboard for drover corrals, agents and tasks
author: Ferenyl

scripts.start: [ -f web/dist/index.html ] && [ -z "$(find web/src web/index.html shared/src -newer web/dist/index.html -print -quit)" ] || npm run build; npm start -w server
scripts.lint: test -x lint/node_modules/.bin/eslint || npm ci --prefix lint --no-audit --no-fund --silent; lint/node_modules/.bin/eslint -c lint/eslint.config.js .
